Premium Homemade Smash Burgers in Rosemont

JOYO BURGER MASSON - ROSEMONT'S BURGER DESTINATION

Discover Montreal's most beloved burger destination on Masson Street in Rosemont-La Petite-Patrie. Our flagship location has been serving premium homemade smash burgers to the vibrant Promenade Masson community since day one. Located in the heart of one of Montreal's most dynamic neighborhoods, we're proud to be part of Rosemont's thriving food scene.

MASSON FAVORITES

Discover what makes our Masson location special - premium homemade burgers, hand-cut fries, and local craft beer, all made fresh daily.

Le Grand

Our signature double smash patty burger with cheddar, lettuce, tomato, onion, and JOYO sauce. House-ground beef, hand-formed and smashed to perfection.

Hand-Cut Fries

Real potatoes, hand-cut fresh every morning. Crispy golden perfection that pairs perfectly with our premium burgers. Never frozen, always fresh.

Local Craft Beer

Carefully curated selection of Montreal's finest craft beers on tap. The perfect complement to your premium burger experience in Rosemont.

FIND US ON MASSON STREET

DISCOVER ROSEMONT-LA PETITE-PATRIE

Our Masson Street location puts you in the heart of one of Montreal's most charming neighborhoods. After enjoying your premium homemade burger, explore the vibrant Promenade Masson with its unique boutiques, cafés, and cultural attractions.

Why Choose JOYO Burger Masson?

As Rosemont's premier burger destination, we've been perfecting our craft since opening. Our Masson Street location serves the diverse Rosemont-La Petite-Patrie community with fresh, premium homemade burgers made from beef ground daily in-house. Whether you're exploring the Promenade Masson, visiting the Botanical Garden, or catching a show at Cinéma Beaubien, JOYO Burger is your perfect meal stop in East Montreal.
